title: 韋帕安杜姆鋁土礦
summary: 以韋帕地區安杜姆鋁土礦為案例，研究淺層礦石、洗選、運輸與復育界面。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A Weipa-region Andoom bauxite case examines shallow ore, washing, transport and rehabilitation interfaces. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位；不同礦區鋁與伴生礦物品質；洗選回水與熱帶雨水界面
v31FocusEn: Bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade; Alumina-related quality and associated minerals across areas; Washing return-water and tropical-rainfall interfaces

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade" and "Alumina-related quality and associated minerals across areas": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade" is correct?
options: 運輸與稱重常以濕噸記錄，但品位、能耗與產量比較可能採乾噸。
一噸濕礦與一噸乾礦可以直接比較品位產能。
兩批礦石的品位只要做算術平均即可。
optionsEn: Transport and scales often report wet tonnes, while grade, energy and production comparisons use dry tonnes.
One wet tonne and one dry tonne can be directly compared for grade throughput.
The arithmetic mean of two ore grades is always the blend grade.
quiz.explanation: 運輸與稱重常以濕噸記錄，但品位、能耗與產量比較可能採乾噸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Transport and scales often report wet tonnes, while grade, energy and production comparisons use dry tonnes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位」如何決定「韋帕安杜姆鋁土礦」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Weipa Andoom bauxite mine”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「韋帕安杜姆鋁土礦」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位」。運輸與稱重常以濕噸記錄，但品位、能耗與產量比較可能採乾噸。含水率若以濕基定義，乾重等於濕重乘固體分率；乾基含水率的分母不同，不能直接代入。降雨會使兩種報表產生假性的產量差。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Weipa Andoom bauxite mine as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade. Transport and scales often report wet tonnes, while grade, energy and production comparisons use dry tonnes. For wet-basis moisture, dry mass equals wet mass times solids fraction; dry-basis moisture has a different denominator. Rainfall can create an apparent production difference between reports. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.questionEn: Using the model Mdry = Mwet·(1−w/100) for "Bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for wet-to-dry mass conversion; input units: Mwet: t wet/h; w: wet-basis mass %. steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Mdry = Mwet·(1−w/100)；代入 Mwet = 650 t wet/h、w = 12 wet-basis mass %，得 572 t/h（濕基與乾基換算的合成教學算例；輸入單位：Mwet: t wet/h; w: wet-basis mass %。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 w 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mdry = Mwet·(1−w/100); with Mwet = 650 t wet/h, w = 12 wet-basis mass % the result is 572 t/h (synthetic teaching example for wet-to-dry mass conversion; input units: Mwet: t wet/h; w: wet-basis mass %. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise w by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：w 增加 10% 時，結果變為 564 t/h（-1.4%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising w by 10% changes the result to 564 t/h (-1.4%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 572 t/h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 w 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 572 t/h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in w with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位」，對合成樣品列出濕重、烘乾後重量與採樣時間，獨立重算含水率；比較批次而非只套用月平均含水率。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

For bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade, list synthetic wet mass, dried mass and sampling time and independently recalculate moisture, comparing batches instead of applying only monthly-average moisture.
quiz.explanation: 針對「鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位」，對合成樣品列出濕重、烘乾後重量與採樣時間，獨立重算含水率；比較批次而非只套用月平均含水率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade, list synthetic wet mass, dried mass and sampling time and independently recalculate moisture, comparing batches instead of applying only monthly-average moisture. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.instruction: 針對「鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位」，對合成樣品列出濕重、烘乾後重量與採樣時間，獨立重算含水率；比較批次而非只套用月平均含水率。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「鋁土礦濕噸與乾基品位」情境，濕噸增長但金屬量不變可能只是水分增加；核對乾重、化驗基準與降雨紀錄可避免誤報產能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the scenario of bauxite wet tonnes versus dry-basis grade, more wet tonnes with unchanged metal may only reflect added water; dry mass, assay basis and rainfall records prevent a false capacity claim. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

knowledge.text: 在「不同礦區鋁與伴生礦物品質」情境，平均品位合格但處理不穩定，可能是粗細粒偏析或未納入的硬度差；分層取樣與粒度分析可以區分兩者。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。
knowledge.textEn: In the scenario of alumina-related quality and associated minerals across areas, acceptable mean grade with unstable processing can arise from size segregation or omitted hardness contrasts; stratified sampling and size analysis discriminate between them. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
